claim: THE DESCRIPTION THAT PASSED 13/13 WOULD HAVE PUBLISHED THE LITERAL TEXT '—' IN 77 PLACES. claim: CHECK X2 PASSED ON A DESCRIPTION ENDING 'Draft only -- no deposit, no metadata edit.' X2 exists to stop draft-stage language being published. ITS MUTANT WAS DRAWN FROM ITS OWN STRING LIST -- it inserted 'DRAFT ONLY. Not deposited.' -- so the mutant could only prove the list is consulted, never that the list is adequate. A mutant built from the constant it tests is not an independent control. Repaired to a case-insensitive word-boundary pattern with an explicit quotation allowance, and given three mutants none of which appears in the pattern; all three are rejected, the first being verbatim the sentence that got through.
